title: Terracept
safeHtml:
'''Terracept''' is the official name of the Origin World of Project Nazca. Before the establishment of the City World, Terracept was the main area of development for Nazca Railway between 2012 and March 10 2015, when development of Terracept terminated due to the release of Java Edition 1.8.

Geography

Terracept consists of the four major areas as follows:

  • Terracept Continent: The center of Terracept. It is home to both Terminals of Terracept Division and is also home to the access point to Golden Division and Los Sengas.
  • Tremend Sea: A snowy continent similar to the modern-day Ingress in Los Sengas. Located to the southwest of Terracept Continent.
  • Vertin Peninsula: A peninsula located to the north of Terracept Continent.
  • Tropic Continent: A continent located to the north of Vertin Peninsula.

Nations

Terracept was also formerly home to four different nations between players, and they are named as follows:

  • United States of EtErNalGLX: Located at the southwest of Terracept Continent.
  • The Republic Kingdom of Alexandria: Located at the east of Terracept Continent near , and
  • Gemu: The northernmost nation in Terracept Continent.
  • Eukaryote Kingdom: The nation that housed the most Terracept Division stations.

Fun Facts

  • Unlike Los Sengas, which is based on "Limited Creative Modes", Terracept is based on Survival Modes. Therefore, all Nazca Railway stations in Terracept Division contained Basic Station Facilities, such as Repair Stations, Brewing Stations, Enchantment Stations and Workshops. This characteristic would be passed on to Stations that are built in the first three Seasons and Pre-Season 4 of Los Sengas Division.

  • A naturally spawned village is located at the northeast of this island. Among the islands on West Metropolis Archipelago, this island is the only island with a naturally spawned village.

title: The Shuttle
safeHtml:
''' (Formally named Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division Shuttle)''', is a Point-to-Point (P2P) Personal Rapid Transit (PRT) system operated by NR Los Sengas Division.

Concept

The Shuttle is designed to be a P2P service and does not have clearly defined lines. However, it runs in the style of a cobweb, with different junctions of the "cobweb" being the "stations of The Shuttle. Passengers can directly choose his destination from any given station on this system.

Proper Nouns

Node

"Node" is the term for "Stations" in The Shuttle. For instance, if Sava has a station for The Shuttle, it would be named "Sava Node" instead of "Sava Station.

Link

"Link" is the term for "Line that reaches the Destination". For instance, if a passenger travels on any line that can directly go to Sava Node, and head towards Sava Node, the line that he takes would be referred to as "Sava Link".

Routing Terminal

A facility for passengers to choose his/her destination node in any given node. It also has a function to "Reset Destination".

List of Links

  • (Destination: Metropolis Terminal)

  • (Destination: Wui King Node)
  • (Destination: Central Numpool Node)

Development Mode

The Shuttle runs as an independent rail system. It does not appear in Main Chapters of Nazca Railway, but would randomly appear in different places.

Operation Mode

The Shuttle operates in accordance to the Terracept Division with regards that it does not have Platform Screen Doors, does not have Departure Routines and has its own style of announcements. Moreover, in accordance to the concept of The Shuttle, one platform can have more than one destination. Therefore, passengers shall choose their own destination first before proceeding to the respective platform. It should be noted that The Shuttle runs in the same speed as Veloducts.

safeHtml:
'''Through Services''' (Named '''In-Train Interchange''' in Nazca Railway), is a concept of passenger transport that involves a vehicle travelling between lines, networks or operators on a regularly specified schedule, on which the passenger can remain on board without alighting. This mode of operation is very frequently seen in railways, so that passengers have a more convenient route to reach their destination.

title: Tin Wing
safeHtml:
'''Tin Wing''' is one of the Sub-Districts of Asylum. It is located at the Central North Area of Asylum, and its District Code is 29-04.

History

There has been speculation regarding the origins of the name Tin Wing. One of them has to do with paying homage to Jaime Cheung, a member of the Hong Kong-based Beanies, and the other symbolizes the fact that this district has gathered talents from all across Los Sengas and that citizens in this Sub-District have a Higher Average IQ.

Currently, all land transport to and from West Asylum must pass through Tin Wing, and could only leave Asylum through Beanies Road. This causes a Bottleneck Effect regarding vehicles until Asylum and Snowty can be connecte by a Major Road. Therefore, Tin Wing can be seen as a junction for road Transport as both Pak Hoi Road and Beanies Road need to carry a significant amount of Traffic Flow.

In response to the name of this District, this District is home to the only "School Estate" in Asylum, which houses a total of nine Secondary and Primary Schools.

During Initial Construction, the Developer has taken notice of a lack of Home Ownership Scheme housing supply within Asylum, and has therefore made the decision to increase supply of such housing within this Sub-District in order to provide increased housing opportunities for the lower Middle Class. As a result, this Sub-District has the largest proportion of Home Ownership Scheme housing in Asylum.
